verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵ֗ת מִכְתָּֽם׃ לְדָוִ֥ד הַֽאֻמְנָ֗ם תְּדַבֵּר֑וּן צֶ֭דֶק אֵ֣לֶם תִּ֝שְׁפְּט֗וּ מֵישָׁרִ֥ים בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’al- taš·ḥêṯ miḵ·tām lə·ḏā·wiḏ ha·’um·nām tə·ḏab·bê·rūn ṣe·ḏeq ’ê·lem tiš·pə·ṭū mê·šā·rîm bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of Do Not Destroy A Miktam of David Do you indeed speak justly O rulers Do you judge uprightly O sons of men

verses.original: אַף־ בְּלֵב֮ תִּפְעָ֫ל֥וּן עוֹלֹ֪ת יְ֝דֵיכֶ֗ם תְּפַלֵּֽסֽוּן׃ חֲמַ֥ס בָּאָ֡רֶץ
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- bə·lêḇ tip̄·‘ā·lūn ‘ō·w·lōṯ yə·ḏê·ḵem tə·p̄al·lê·sūn ḥă·mas bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: No in your hearts you devise injustice with your hands you mete out violence on the earth

verses.original: רְשָׁעִ֣ים זֹ֣רוּ מֵרָ֑חֶם דֹּבְרֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃ תָּע֥וּ מִ֝בֶּ֗טֶן
verses.transliteration: rə·šā·‘îm zō·rū mê·rā·ḥem dō·ḇə·rê ḵā·zāḇ tā·‘ū mib·be·ṭen
verses.literal: The wicked are estranged from the womb the liars . . . go astray from birth

verses.original: חֲמַת־ לָ֗מוֹ כִּדְמ֥וּת חֲמַת־ נָחָ֑שׁ כְּמוֹ־ פֶ֥תֶן חֵ֝רֵ֗שׁ יַאְטֵ֥ם אָזְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·maṯ- lā·mōw kiḏ·mūṯ ḥă·maṯ- nā·ḥāš kə·mōw- p̄e·ṯen ḥê·rêš ya’·ṭêm ’ā·zə·nōw
verses.literal: Their venom - [is] like the venom of a snake like a cobra that shuts . . . its ears

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ יִ֭שְׁמַע לְק֣וֹל מְלַחֲשִׁ֑ים מְחֻכָּֽם׃ חוֹבֵ֖ר חֲבָרִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer lō- yiš·ma‘ lə·qō·wl mə·la·ḥă·šîm mə·ḥuk·kām ḥō·w·ḇêr ḥă·ḇā·rîm
verses.literal: vvv refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell . . .

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים הֲרָס־ שִׁנֵּ֥ימוֹ בְּפִ֑ימוֹ יְהוָֽה׃ נְתֹ֣ץ׀ מַלְתְּע֥וֹת כְּ֝פִירִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm hă·rās- šin·nê·mōw bə·p̄î·mōw Yah·weh nə·ṯōṣ mal·tə·‘ō·wṯ kə·p̄î·rîm
verses.literal: O God shatter their teeth in their mouths O LORD tear out the fangs of the lions

verses.original: יִמָּאֲס֣וּ כְמוֹ־ מַ֭יִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־ לָ֑מוֹ יִדְרֹ֥ךְ חִצּוֹ כְּמ֣וֹ יִתְמֹלָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yim·mā·’ă·sū ḵə·mōw- ma·yim yiṯ·hal·lə·ḵū- lā·mōw yiḏ·rōḵ ḥiṣ·ṣō kə·mōw yiṯ·mō·lā·lū
verses.literal: May they vanish like water that runs off when they draw the bow may their arrows be blunted

verses.original: כְּמ֣וֹ שַׁ֭בְּלוּל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ תֶּ֣מֶס אֵ֝֗שֶׁת נֵ֥פֶל בַּל־ חָ֥זוּ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw šab·bə·lûl ya·hă·lōḵ te·mes ’ê·šeṯ nê·p̄el bal- ḥā·zū šā·meš
verses.literal: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime like a woman’s stillborn child may they never see the sun

verses.original: בְּטֶ֤רֶם סִּֽירֹתֵיכֶ֣ם יָבִ֣ינוּ אָטָ֑ד חַ֥י כְּמוֹ־ כְּמוֹ־ חָ֝ר֗וֹן יִשְׂעָרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem sî·rō·ṯê·ḵem yā·ḇî·nū ’ā·ṭāḏ ḥay kə·mōw- kə·mōw- ḥā·rō·wn yiś·‘ā·ren·nū
verses.literal: Before your pots can feel [the burning] thorns whether green or . . . dry He will sweep them away

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק יִשְׂמַ֣ח כִּי־ חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם יִ֝רְחַ֗ץ פְּעָמָ֥יו בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq yiś·maḥ kî- ḥā·zāh nā·qām yir·ḥaṣ pə·‘ā·māw bə·ḏam hā·rā·šā‘
verses.literal: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked

verses.original: אָ֭דָם וְיֹאמַ֣ר אַךְ־ פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק יֵשׁ־ אַ֥ךְ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām wə·yō·mar ’aḵ- pə·rî laṣ·ṣad·dîq yêš- ’aḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm šō·p̄ə·ṭîm bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then men will say There is surely a reward for the righteous There is surely a God who judges the earth
